description: Archive a whole project whose work is finished. It becomes read-only for everybody (like a pause) and leaves the lists: list_projects and the project switcher no longer show it, and search_issues counts its issues as archived — `project = AN` answers empty with archivedLeftOut, `archived in (true, false)` includes them. It stays readable by its link and through list_projects with includeArchived, and its export works. Nothing is deleted and no issue is changed: unarchive_project puts everything back as it was, a pause included. Unfinished issues do not stop it — the answer says how many there were (openIssues); confirm with the person when there are any. Only the project's lead (or its parent's, or an admin).
name: archive_project
title: Archive project
